init.title: Connection policy
init.description: A connected SwitchBot keeps its radio awake for connection events, which costs battery. These defaults only keep the link across a burst of adjustments; to make a scheduled command instant, call the prewarm action 30-60 seconds ahead instead of holding the link.

data.linger_seconds: Keep the connection after a command
data.hold_connection: Hold connection (solar or mains powered units only)

data_description.linger_seconds: Seconds to keep the link open after a command you issued, reset by each new command. Polls and read-backs never extend it. 0 behaves like the core integration.
data_description.hold_connection: Keep a connection open permanently. This is only sensible for a solar or mains powered unit: on batteries it will drain them. It is suspended automatically below the low battery threshold.
data_description.prewarm_seconds: How long the prewarm action keeps the link open. Call it from the same automation that is about to move the device, 30-60 seconds ahead.
data_description.low_battery_percent: At or below this level, linger and hold are suspended to protect the battery, and a repair is raised. Prewarm still works.
data_description.retry_count: How many times pySwitchbot retries a failed command. Each retry reconnects, and Home Assistant re-scores the proxies for it.
data_description.connect_timeout: Hard cap on a single connect attempt. Lower means a bad proxy path fails fast and the retry can pick another proxy.

prewarm.name: Prewarm
prewarm.description: Connects to the device now and keeps the link open for the prewarm duration, so the next command runs without waiting for a connection.

low_battery.title: {name} battery is low
low_battery.description: {name} is at {battery}%, at or below the {threshold}% low battery threshold. Keeping the connection open (linger and hold) is suspended until it recovers, so commands will pay a connection again. The prewarm action still works. Charge or replace the battery, or lower the threshold in the integration options.

device_not_found.message: Could not find a SwitchBot at {address} through a Bluetooth proxy or adapter that can make connections.
